name: raw_orders
description: Raw order data ingested from the ShopStream transactional database. Contains every order placed on the platform, including pending, completed, cancelled, and refunded orders. No transformations applied — this is the source-of-truth landing zone.

name: raw_customers
description: Raw customer profile data from the CRM system. Includes all registered customers with their contact details and account metadata. Updated daily via full extract.

name: raw_payments
description: Raw payment transactions from the payment gateway (Stripe). Each record represents a single payment attempt, which may succeed or fail. Multiple payment attempts can exist for a single order.

name: raw_products
description: Raw product catalog data from the inventory management system. Contains all products ever listed on the platform, including discontinued items.

name: raw_order_items
description: Raw line items for each order. Each record is one product within an order (an order can contain multiple items). Links orders to products with quantity and pricing.

name: raw_shipping_events
description: Raw shipping and delivery tracking events from logistics partners. Each record is a single tracking event (e.g., 'picked up', 'in transit', 'delivered'). Multiple events per shipment.

name: raw_suppliers
description: Raw supplier/vendor master data. Contains information about companies that supply products to ShopStream.

name: stg_orders
description: Staged orders — cleaned and validated from raw_orders. Invalid orders removed, data types standardized, duplicates eliminated. Ready for business logic application.

name: stg_customers
description: Staged customers — cleaned from raw_customers. Email addresses validated, names standardized, country codes normalized to ISO format.

name: stg_payments
description: Staged payments — cleaned from raw_payments. Amounts converted to USD, failed payment attempts flagged, duplicates removed based on payment gateway idempotency keys.

name: stg_products
description: Staged products — cleaned from raw_products. Product names trimmed, categories standardized, prices validated. Discontinued products still included but flagged.

name: stg_order_items
description: Staged order line items — cleaned from raw_order_items. Quantities validated (must be > 0), orphaned items (no matching order) removed.

name: stg_shipping
description: Staged shipping events — cleaned from raw_shipping_events. Events deduplicated, timestamps standardized to UTC, carrier names normalized.

name: curated_orders
description: Conformed order fact table — the single source of truth for order analytics. Combines staged orders with payment status and shipping status. Each row is one order with its final state. Used by all downstream reporting.

name: curated_customers
description: Conformed customer dimension — enriched customer profiles with computed metrics. Includes lifetime value, order count, and current segment. Used for customer analytics and segmentation.

name: curated_products
description: Conformed product dimension — enriched with sales performance metrics. Includes total units sold, revenue generated, and profit margin. Used for product analytics and inventory decisions.

name: curated_order_items
description: Conformed order line items fact table — each row is one product within an order, enriched with product details and computed line totals. Bridge table between orders and products.

name: rpt_daily_sales
description: Daily sales summary report — aggregated from curated_orders and curated_order_items. One row per day with total revenue, order count, average order value, and refund rate. Powers the executive sales dashboard.

name: rpt_customer_segments
description: Customer segmentation report — aggregated from curated_customers and curated_orders. Breaks down customer base by segment (standard/premium/vip) with cohort metrics. Used for marketing targeting and retention analysis.

name: rpt_product_performance
description: Product performance report — aggregated from curated_products and curated_order_items. Ranks products by revenue, units sold, and margin. Used by merchandising team for inventory and pricing decisions.

name: rpt_shipping_sla
description: Shipping SLA compliance report — tracks delivery performance by carrier. Calculates percentage of orders delivered within SLA (3 business days). Used by operations team to evaluate logistics partners.

name: rpt_revenue_by_country
description: Revenue breakdown by customer country — aggregated from curated_orders and curated_customers. Shows geographic distribution of sales. Powers the regional sales dashboard and helps identify expansion opportunities.
